source.reference: The expansion budget rule: inside the same package and within expansion_budget_files it is an advisory finding; beyond the budget execution halts

defect: Five files are touched inside the declared package but outside paths_allowed, against an expansion budget of three.
why_it_is_hard: Each file on its own is within the rule that makes expansion advisory. Only the count violates the contract, so a reviewer reasoning file by file never sees it.
